|sellprice = 800 |quality = false }} '''Jewels Of The Sea''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be obtained from [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 5]]. The chance for a treasure chest to contain the book starts at 2% and increases by 0.1% for each treasure chest opened until it is obtained. Then the chance stays at 2.1% permanently. It cannot appear until the player has opened at least 3 fishing treasure chests. It can also be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|20000}} starting in Year 3 (≈9% chance to appear). The first reading grants the player a power that makes all fishing treasure chests have a 25% chance to yield 1-6 [[Roe]]. The type of roe obtained is the same as the fish that was caught. Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 100 [[Fishing]] [[Skills|XP]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Penny,Willy |like=Elliott |neutral=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus,Leo |dislike=Alex }} ==Bundles== Jewels Of The Sea is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Jewels Of The Sea is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as an orange dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== Jewels Of The Sea is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Trading== One Jewels Of The Sea can be traded to the [[Bookseller]] for either 3 [[Cave Jelly]], 3 [[River Jelly]], or 3 [[Sea Jelly]], provided the player has already obtained the power from this book. ==Trivia== *The power from this book can result in the player receiving types of roe which are otherwise unobtainable, namely [[Squid]] and [[Midnight Squid]] roes. ==References== See FishingRod::openTreasureMenuEndFunction in the game code.
